decisions.decision: Sessions DDL and index plan approved as design.md gives them
decisions.why: All three reads order by charge_stop_date_time; one ascending index serves them all.

decisions.decision: mirror_watermarks cursors are deleted, not mapped
decisions.why: An absent cursor already means re-read once; the mirror is an idempotent upsert.

decisions.decision: VerifySession is re-keyed on tesla_id, not stripped
decisions.why: Its account_id predicate is the write path's only tenant check; the handler does none.

decisions.decision: The processor.go per-vehicle mirror rewrite lands here, not in tier 3
decisions.why: The re-keyed watermark leaves the account-grouped loop with no cursor to read.

decisions.decision: T2, T3 and T4 go to ONE serial worker instead of three dispatches
decisions.why: They form a hard compile chain and each is prescriptive. Three dispatches would re-read the ~12k-token doc pack twice more and leave two non-building states.
